order: Rotate arms left by task-seed pair index modulo 4; run sequentially in one Unity slot.
freeze_rules: All seeds predeclared from checked-in experiment_presets_backup.json; no outcome-based replacement or retuning.
Current provenance-aware source only; v2 old-source results remain separate.
Tree/scout/transport use preset horizons. Suppression is explicitly a 15-step window, NOT the preset 100-step full task.

Suppression progress fraction/AUC unsupported: dynamic fire population has no trustworthy fixed denominator. Report original validator, fire_active, extinguished/burned counts and water changes separately.
Tree progress includes initial clear cells: report initial reward and delta, not only final fraction.
Include task failures, timeouts, infrastructure failures and unknown outcomes; no selective retry.
Gate excluded. No manual stage contracts, capacity planner or semantic action guards in any arm.
Projector-off retains topology policy, not necessarily realized closed-loop trajectories. No causal usefulness or significance claims.
Record raw chats, generated communication, sent/delivered/suppressed feedback, action-boundary snapshots, original validator, complete returned usage and PNGs. Derived reports do not alter raw data.
